name: Toudou Heisuke
source:
From his sheltered childhood Todou can appear naïve and will often spring into a situation without thinking. Hates to be treated like a child, but looks up to [url=http://vndb.org/c1462]Nagakura[/url] as a big brother.

[From [url=http://hajimenokizu.com/bakumatsu-renka-shinsengumi/basic_info.html]BRS no Koibito[/url]]
